name: jira-dev-workflow
description: End-to-end Jira ticket workflow: read ticket via Atlassian MCP, create compliant git branch, scope with /grill-with-context, hand off to sdd-python-orchestrator, commit/push via jira-git-committer, close out in Jira. Branch-name/author-email regexes and Atlassian MCP knowledge live in this plugin's git-devops-conventions and atlassian-jira-mcp skills; the commit-message format is owned by the skills plugin's commit-message-generator.
